proofs.text: Apply the v0.9.5 fixture and verify every character printed is below U+2190 or is the arrow or the horizontal rule, and that the last line is `→ Next: run purlin:status to see where every rule stands.`; decline the records question and verify the last line is `→ Next: run purlin:init --update again for records.`

reasons: PROOF-20 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: What the run prints carries no emoji, and its last line names the next step: the update again while something is left, otherwise `purlin:status`

tests.name: test_a_run_that_leaves_work_names_it
test_the_run_ends_by_naming_the_next_step
test_what_the_update_prints_carries_no_emoji
